records.literal_gloss: For the director, with stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: with stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. With stringed instruments, on the sheminith. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments, set to "the eighth". A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes, sur la sheminith. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes, sur la sheminith. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes, sur « la huitième ». Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa sheminithi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa ala za nyuzi, kwa mtindo wa "ya nane". Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda, sobre la seminit. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda, sobre la seminit. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda, en «la octava». Canto de David.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: với đàn dây, theo [điệu] Sê-mi-nít. [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Với đàn dây, theo điệu Sê-mi-nít. Thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để chơi bằng đàn dây, theo "cung thứ tám". Bài ca của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어, 스미닛에 따라. 다윗의 시.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어, 스미닛에 따라. 다윗의 시.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해 다윗이 지은 노래. 현악기로 "여덟째"에 맞추어 연주한다.

pt.L: Para o regente: com instrumentos de cordas, sobre a seminite. Salmo de Davi.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Com instrumentos de cordas, sobre a seminite. Salmo de Davi.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Para ser tocado com instrumentos de cordas, no tom chamado "a oitava". Canção de Davi.

am.L: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች፣ በሸሚኒት። የዳዊት መዝሙር።
am.B: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች፣ በሸሚኒት። የዳዊት መዝሙር።
am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች፣ «በስምንተኛው» ስልት የሚዘመር። ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: तारवाले बाजों के साथ, शमीनीत पर। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। तारवाले बाजों के साथ, शमीनीत पर। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। तारवाले बाजों पर, "आठवें" के अनुसार बजाने के लिए। दाऊद का गीत।

ru.L: Руководителю хора: на струнных инструментах, на шеминит. Псалом Давида.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. На струнных инструментах, на шеминит. Псалом Давида.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Исполнять на струнных инструментах, по «восьмой». Песнь Давида.

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。弦楽器に合わせて、シェミニトに合わせて。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。弦楽器に合わせて、シェミニトに合わせて。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。弦楽器で演奏し、「第八」という調べに合わせる。ダビデの歌。

uk.L: Для диригента: на струнних інструментах, на шемініт. Псалом Давида.
uk.B: Для диригента хору. На струнних інструментах, на шемініт. Псалом Давида.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Грати на струнних інструментах, на лад «восьмий». Пісня Давида.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the sheminith: "the eighth", a musical direction
decisions.reason: The word (sheminit) means "the eighth". 1 Chronicles 15:21 uses the same phrase of Levites playing lyres. It may name an instrument, a pitch or a tune; its sense is no longer known, so Literal and Balanced keep the word.

decisions.choice: set to "the eighth"; song
decisions.reason: Readable translates the word and, as in 3:1, says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "la sheminith" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced); "« la huitième »" at Readable
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth" and is a musical direction whose sense is lost (m3). French follows the English level by level: the name where it keeps the name, the plain meaning of the word where it translates.

decisions.choice: "sheminithi" kept as a name (L, B); "kwa mtindo wa \"ya nane\"" (in the style of "the eighth") at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "the eighth", but what it directed in the music is no longer known (m3). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, as the English does; Readable translates the word and says it is a way of playing, without guessing which.

decisions.choice: la seminit (L, B); «la octava» (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sheminith means "the eighth", but what it meant for the music (a tuning, an eight-stringed instrument, a lower octave) is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word, Readable gives its plain meaning, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Sê-mi-nít" kept as a name (L, B); "cung thứ tám" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth", but no one knows what in the music it named (see the meaning decision). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, as the English does; Readable gives the plain meaning of the word in quotation marks, without claiming to know more. "quãng tám" (octave) would claim more than is known.

decisions.choice: "스미닛" kept as a name (L, B); "여덟째" (the eighth) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means "the eighth" but its musical sense is lost (meaning decision m3). Korean keeps the word as a name at Literal and Balanced, as the English keeps "sheminith", and translates it at Readable as the English does, without guessing more.

decisions.choice: a seminite (L, B); no tom chamado "a oitava" (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Chronicles 15:21 has the same term in Portuguese: Literal and Balanced keep the word, written "seminite", and Readable translates it, as the English does (m3).

decisions.choice: on the sheminith as "በሸሚኒት" (L, B), as 1 Chronicles 15:21; Readable gives the sense, "«በስምንተኛው» ስልት"
decisions.reason: The heading table keeps the musical term as a name; Readable follows the English in giving its literal sense, "the eighth".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "शमीनीत" (L, B); "आठवें" (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth", a musical direction whose exact sense is lost (meaning m3). As the poetry note asks, the Hindi follows the English level: Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, Readable translates it.

decisions.choice: шеминит (L, B), as 1 Chronicles 15:21; по «восьмой» (R)
decisions.reason: The word means "the eighth", a musical direction whose exact sense is lost (m3). Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, in the form of 1 Chronicles 15:21 in this translation; Readable translates it in quotation marks, as the English does, without guessing whether it is an octave, a mode or an eight-stringed instrument.

decisions.choice: 'al-hasheminit "シェミニトに合わせて" (L, B), "「第八」という調べに合わせる" (R), as 1 Chronicles 15:21
decisions.reason: The term is a musical direction whose sense is uncertain (m3); Literal and Balanced transliterate it as the English does, and Readable translates it in quotation marks as the English Readable does, in the form 1 Chronicles settled.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, do not in your anger rebuke me, and do not in your wrath discipline me.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger rebuke me, \q and do not in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wrath discipline me.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct me, do not do it in anger; \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} discipline me, do not do it in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, do not be angry when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct me. \q Do not punish me in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne me reprends pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, \q et ne me corrige pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me reprends, que ce ne soit pas avec colère ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corriges, que ce ne soit pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ne sois pas en colère quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corriges. \q Ne me punis pas dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} usinikaripie, wala katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} usinirudi.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unaponikosoa, usifanye hivyo kwa hasira; unaponirudi, usifanye hivyo kwa ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira me reprendas, \q y no en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furor me disciplines.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando me corrijas, no lo hagas con enojo; \q cuando me disciplines, no lo hagas con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furia.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} enojes cuando me corrijas. \q No me castigues con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} furia.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin đừng trách phạt tôi trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và đừng sửa phạt tôi trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quở trách tôi, xin đừng làm trong cơn giận; khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa phạt tôi, xin đừng làm trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sửa dạy tôi, xin đừng nổi giận. Xin đừng trừng phạt tôi trong cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 진노로 저를 꾸짖지 마시고, 주님의 분노로 저를 징계하지 마십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡으실 때 노하여 하지 마시고, 저를 징계하실 때 진노하여 하지 마십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 바로잡으실 때 화내지 말아 주십시오. 분노하셔서 저를 벌하지 말아 주십시오.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira me repreendas, \q e não no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} furor me disciplines.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me corrigires, não o faças com ira; \q quando me disciplinares, não o faças com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fúria.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, não fiques irado quando me corrigires. \q Não me castigues com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fúria.

am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስትወቅሰኝ በቁጣ አይሁን፤ ስታርመኝም በመዓትህ አይሁን።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስታርመኝ አትቆጣ። በታላቅ ቁጣህ አትቅጣኝ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने क्रोध में मुझे न डाँट, और अपने कोप में मेरी ताड़ना न कर।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जब तू मुझे सुधारे, तो क्रोध में ऐसा न कर; जब तू मेरी ताड़ना करे, तो अपने रोष में न कर।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जब तू मुझे सुधारे तो मुझ पर क्रोधित न हो। अपने रोष में मुझे दंड न दे।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, не в гневе {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} укоряй меня, и не в ярости {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} вразумляй меня.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} исправляешь меня, не делай этого в гневе; когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} наказываешь меня, не делай этого в своей ярости.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, не гневайся, когда исправляешь меня. Не наказывай меня в своей ярости.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの怒りによってわたしを責めないでください。あなたの憤りによってわたしを懲らしめないでください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを責められるときに、怒りをもってしないでください。わたしを懲らしめられるときに、激しい憤りをもってしないでください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを正されるときに、怒らないでください。激しく怒って、わたしを罰しないでください。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, не в {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} гніві докоряй мені, і не в {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} люті карай мене.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} виправляєш мене, не роби цього в гніві; коли караєш мене, не роби цього у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} люті.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, не гнівайся, коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} виправляєш мене. Не карай мене у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} люті.

decisions.choice: not in your anger: correction without anger
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not ask to escape correction, only that it not come in anger, as Jeremiah prays: "correct me, LORD, but with justice, not in your anger" (Jeremiah 10:24). Psalm 38:2 opens with the same words.

decisions.choice: rebuke, discipline: correction, as a father corrects
decisions.reason: To rebuke (yakach) is to set right, and to discipline (yasar) is to train by correction, as a father does a son (Proverbs 3:11-12).

decisions.choice: wrath: burning anger
decisions.reason: The word (chemah) is heat, the burning of anger.

decisions.choice: when you correct me, do not do it in anger
alternatives: do not rebuke me in your anger
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the correction first to make plain that the prayer is about the anger, not the correction (m1).

decisions.choice: Negative requests to God "〜ないでください"; chemah "憤り" (L), "激しい憤り" (B), as Lamentations
decisions.reason: The Psalter's request form (3:8) in the negative; 'af is 怒り and chemah 憤り, as Lamentations keeps them apart.

source.text: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Be gracious to me, YHWH, for frail [am] I; heal me, YHWH, for terrified are my bones.

en.L: Be gracious to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for withering [am] I; \q heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for my bones are terrified.
en.B: Show me grace, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for I am wasting away; \q heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q for my very bones are shaking.
en.R: Be kind to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because I am weak and fading. \q Heal me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q because my whole body is shaking.

fr.L: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je dépéris ; \q guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car mes os sont épouvantés.
fr.B: Fais-moi grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car je m’épuise ; \q guéris-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car jusqu’à mes os tremblent.
fr.R: Sois bon pour moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que je suis faible et que mes forces s’en vont. \q Guéris-moi, \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que tout mon corps tremble.

sw.L: Unifanyie neema, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ninanyauka mimi; uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana mifupa yangu imetetemeka kwa hofu.
sw.B: Unihurumie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ninadhoofika; uniponye, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana hata mifupa yangu inatetemeka.
sw.R: Unionee huruma, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu nimedhoofika na ninafifia. Uniponye, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu mwili wangu wote unatetemeka.

es.L: Ten piedad de mí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque desfallecido [estoy] yo; \q sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque mis huesos están aterrados.
es.B: Muéstrame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gracia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque me estoy consumiendo; \q sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque hasta mis huesos tiemblan.
es.R: Sé bondadoso conmigo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque estoy débil y sin fuerzas. \q Sáname, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque todo mi cuerpo tiembla.

vi.L: Xin thương xót tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tôi [đang] héo hon; xin chữa lành tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì xương cốt tôi kinh hãi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin ban ơn cho tôi, vì tôi đang mòn mỏi; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành tôi, vì đến xương cốt tôi cũng run rẩy.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tỏ lòng tốt với tôi, vì tôi yếu đuối và kiệt sức. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chữa lành tôi, vì cả thân thể tôi đang run rẩy.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 제가 시들어 가기 때문입니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 제 뼈가 떨리기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 제가 쇠약해져 갑니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 제 뼈마디까지 떨립니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 불쌍히 여겨 주십시오. 저는 힘이 없고 시들어 갑니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 고쳐 주십시오. 온몸이 떨립니다.

pt.L: Sê gracioso comigo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque murchando [estou] eu; \q cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q porque os meus ossos estão apavorados.
pt.B: Mostra-me a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque estou definhando; \q cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q porque até os meus ossos tremem.
pt.R: Sê bondoso comigo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, porque estou fraco e sem forças. \q Cura-me, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q porque o meu corpo inteiro está tremendo.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጠውልጌአለሁና ራራልኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አጥንቶቼ ተሸብረዋልና ፈውሰኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እየመነመንኩ ነውና ራራልኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አጥንቶቼ እንኳ ይንቀጠቀጣሉና ፈውሰኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ደክሜአለሁ፤ እየከሰምኩም ነው፤ ስለዚህ ቸርነትህን አሳየኝ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መላ ሰውነቴ ይንቀጠቀጣልና ፈውሰኝ።

hi.L: मुझ पर अनुग्रह कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मैं मुरझा रहा [हूँ]; मुझे चंगा कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मेरी हड्डियाँ घबरा गई हैं।
hi.B: मुझ पर अनुग्रह कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मैं घुलता जा रहा हूँ; मुझे चंगा कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मेरी हड्डियाँ तक काँप रही हैं।
hi.R: मुझ पर दया कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मैं कमज़ोर होकर मुरझा रहा हूँ। मुझे चंगा कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, क्योंकि मेरा सारा शरीर काँप रहा है।

ru.L: Помилуй меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ведь я увядаю; исцели меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ведь мои кости объяты ужасом.
ru.B: Будь милостив ко мне, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ведь я угасаю; исцели меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ведь даже кости мои дрожат.
ru.R: Будь добр ко мне, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, потому что я слаб и угасаю. Исцели меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, потому что всё моё тело дрожит.

ja.L: わたしをあわれんでください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。わたしは衰え果てているからだ。わたしを癒やしてください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。わたしの骨がおののいているからだ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしに恵みを示してください。わたしはやせ衰えている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを癒やしてください。わたしの骨まで震えている。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしをあわれんでください。わたしは弱って、力がなくなっていく。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしをいやしてください。体中が震えている。

uk.L: Змилуйся наді мною, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо зникаю я; зціли мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо мої кості нажахані.
uk.B: Змилуйся наді мною, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо я марнію; зціли мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо тремтять самі мої кості.
uk.R: Будь добрий до мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо я слабну й згасаю. Зціли мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо все моє тіло тремтить.

decisions.choice: withering: weak and fading
decisions.reason: The word ('umlal) is used of plants and fields that wither (Joel 1:10, 12; Isaiah 24:7). The psalmist's strength is drying up.

decisions.choice: terrified: shaken, in dismay
decisions.reason: The verb (bahal) means to be shaken with terror. It comes three times: his bones (here), his soul (verse 4), and at the end his enemies (verse 11), who are shaken as he was.

decisions.choice: my bones: my whole body, my inmost self
decisions.reason: The bones stand for the whole person, body and strength (Psalm 22:15; 32:3). The psalm sounds like serious illness as well as danger from enemies (verse 8).

decisions.choice: my whole body
decisions.reason: Readable says what "my bones" means here (m3).

decisions.choice: be gracious (ḥanan) as "ራራልኝ" (have pity on me, L, B), "ቸርነትህን አሳየኝ" (R)
decisions.reason: "ራራልኝ" keeps ḥanan apart from the words for mercy (raḥamim) and loyal love (ḥesed) in these psalms (4:2; 6:3).

decisions.choice: rafa' "癒やす" (L, B), "いやす" (R); 'atsamai "わたしの骨" (L, B), "体中" (R)
decisions.reason: The OT spellings for heal; Readable says what the bones stand for (m3), as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְאַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And my soul is terrified exceedingly; and you, YHWH, until when?

en.L: And my soul is terrified exceedingly; \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, until when?
en.B: My soul is shaken to its depths. \q But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long?
en.R: I am so afraid. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, how long will it be before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} help me?

fr.L: Et mon âme est épouvantée à l’extrême ; \q et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à quand ?
fr.B: Je suis bouleversé jusqu’au fond de moi. \q Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, jusqu’à quand ?
fr.R: J’ai tellement peur ! \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, combien de temps faudra-t-il encore avant que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viennes m’aider ?

sw.L: Na nafsi yangu imetetemeka kwa hofu mno; {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hata lini?
sw.B: Nafsi yangu imetikiswa hadi ndani kabisa. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hata lini?
sw.R: Ninaogopa sana. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, itachukua muda gani hadi unisaidie?

es.L: Y mi alma está aterrada en gran manera; \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo?
es.B: Mi alma está estremecida hasta lo más hondo. \q Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿hasta cuándo?
es.R: Tengo mucho miedo. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¿cuánto tiempo pasará antes de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me ayudes?

vi.L: Và linh hồn tôi kinh hãi vô cùng; còn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến bao giờ?
vi.B: Linh hồn tôi bị chấn động tận đáy sâu. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho đến bao giờ?
vi.R: Tôi sợ hãi vô cùng. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, còn bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới giúp tôi?

ko.L: 그리고 제 영혼이 몹시 떨립니다. 그러나 주님은, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제까지입니까?
ko.B: 제 영혼이 속속들이 떨립니다. 그런데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제까지입니까?
ko.R: 저는 너무나 두렵습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제쯤 저를 도와주시겠습니까?

pt.L: E a minha alma está apavorada em extremo; \q e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, até quando?
pt.B: A minha alma está abalada até o fundo. \q Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, até quando?
pt.R: Eu estou com muito medo. \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, quanto tempo vai demorar até que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ajudes?

am.L: ነፍሴም እጅግ ተሸብራለች፤ አንተም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እስከ መቼ?
am.B: ነፍሴ እስከ ጥልቁ ተናውጣለች። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ ግን እስከ መቼ?
am.R: እጅግ ፈርቻለሁ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ልትረዳኝ እስከ መቼ ትዘገያለህ?

hi.L: और मेरा प्राण बहुत घबरा गया है; और तू, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, कब तक?
hi.B: मेरा मन भीतर तक काँप उठा है। पर तू, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, कब तक?
hi.R: मैं बहुत डरा हुआ हूँ। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू कब तक रुका रहेगा, कब मेरी मदद करेगा?

ru.L: И душа моя в великом ужасе; а {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, — до каких пор?
ru.B: Моя душа содрогается до самых глубин. Но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, — до каких пор?
ru.R: Мне так страшно. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, сколько ещё ждать, пока {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} мне поможешь?

ja.L: わたしの魂はひどくおののいている。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは、いつまで――。
ja.B: わたしの魂は、奥底まで揺さぶられている。それなのに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、いつまでなのか？
ja.R: わたしは、とてもこわい。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、助けてくださるまで、いつまで待てばいいのか？

uk.L: І моя душа вкрай нажахана; а {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, — доки?
uk.B: Моя душа стривожена до глибин. А {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, — доки?
uk.R: Мені так страшно. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, скільки ще чекати, поки {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} допоможеш мені?

decisions.choice: and you, LORD, how long?: a sentence broken off
decisions.reason: The question breaks off: how long will you stay away, how long will this go on? Psalm 13:2-3 asks "how long" four times.

decisions.choice: my soul: my whole self
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole living person; the terror has reached his very life.

decisions.choice: you: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes the word "you" in a form that is usually feminine, and its notes say to read the usual masculine form. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: how long will it be before you help me?
decisions.reason: Readable finishes the question the psalmist leaves open (m1).

decisions.choice: "linh hồn tôi" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "linh hồn" for nefesh at Literal; Balanced keeps it here too because the whole self, body and soul, is shaken (see the meaning decision), and Readable says simply "tôi".
Nefesh is "प्राण" at Literal, and at Balanced and Readable as the English level says it, as the poetry note settles: here the whole self (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: "あなたは、いつまで――。" (L): the broken-off sentence kept with a dash
alternatives: あなたはいつまで[黙っておられる]のか？
decisions.reason: m1 reads the line as a sentence the psalmist cannot finish; the English Literal keeps a bare "until when?", and the Japanese dash shows the break without supplying a verb, while Balanced and Readable ask the full question.

source.text: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Turn, YHWH, rescue my soul; save me for the sake of your loyal love.

en.L: Return, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, rescue my soul; \q save me for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love.
en.B: Turn back to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and set my life free; \q save me because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} love is loyal.
en.R: Come back, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and rescue me! \q Save me, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} love for me is faithful.

fr.L: Reviens, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, délivre mon âme ; \q sauve-moi à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal.
fr.B: Reviens vers moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et libère ma vie ; \q sauve-moi, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour est fidèle.
fr.R: Reviens, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et délivre-moi ! \q Sauve-moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour pour moi est fidèle.

sw.L: Rudi, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uiokoe nafsi yangu; uniokoe kwa ajili ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma.
sw.B: Unirudie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uyaweke huru maisha yangu; uniokoe kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} haukomi.
sw.R: Rudi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisaidie! Uniokoe, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwangu haukomi.

es.L: Vuelve, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, rescata mi alma; \q sálvame por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal.
es.B: Vuélvete a mí, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y libra mi vida; \q sálvame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor es fiel.
es.R: Regresa, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡y rescátame! \q Sálvame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor por mí es fiel.

vi.L: Xin trở lại, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin giải cứu linh hồn tôi; xin cứu tôi vì cớ tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin quay lại với tôi và giải thoát mạng sống tôi; xin cứu tôi vì tình yêu thương của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thành tín.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin hãy trở lại và giải cứu tôi! Xin cứu tôi, vì tình thương {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho tôi không hề thay đổi.

ko.L: 돌아오십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 영혼을 건져 주십시오. 주님의 한결같은 사랑 때문에 저를 구원해 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제게로 돌아오셔서 제 목숨을 건져 주십시오. 주님의 사랑은 한결같으시니 저를 구원해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 돌아오셔서 저를 구해 주십시오! 저를 향한 주님의 사랑은 변함없으시니 저를 구원해 주십시오.

pt.L: Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, livra a minha alma; \q salva-me por causa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal.
pt.B: Volta-te para mim, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e liberta a minha vida; \q salva-me, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor é leal.
pt.R: Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e me livra! \q Salva-me, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor por mim é fiel.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተመለስ፤ ነፍሴን ታደጋት፤ ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ አድነኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወደ እኔ ተመለስ፤ ሕይወቴንም ነጻ አውጣ፤ ፍቅርህ ጽኑ ነውና አድነኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተመልሰህ ና፤ ታደገኝም! ለእኔ ያለህ ፍቅር ታማኝ ነውና አድነኝ።

hi.L: लौट आ, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरे प्राण को छुड़ा; अपने अटल प्रेम के कारण मुझे बचा।
hi.B: मेरी ओर फिर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, और मेरे जीवन को छुड़ा; मुझे बचा, क्योंकि तेरा प्रेम अटल है।
hi.R: लौट आ, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, और मुझे छुड़ा! मुझे बचा, क्योंकि मेरे लिए तेरा प्रेम अटल है।

ru.L: Вернись, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, вызволи мою душу; спаси меня ради {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви.
ru.B: Вернись ко мне, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, освободи мою жизнь; спаси меня, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} любовь неизменна.
ru.R: Вернись, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и выручи меня! Спаси меня, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} любовь ко мне неизменна.

ja.L: 帰って来てください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。わたしの魂を助け出してください。あなたの誠実のゆえに、わたしを救ってください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしのもとに帰って来て、わたしの命を救い出してください。あなたの変わらぬいつくしみのゆえに、わたしを救ってください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、帰って来て、わたしを助け出してください！あなたは、変わらぬいつくしみを示してくださる方だから、わたしを救ってください。

uk.L: Повернися, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, визволи мою душу; спаси мене заради {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} незмінної любові.
uk.B: Повернися до мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і звільни моє життя; спаси мене, бо {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} любов незмінна.
uk.R: Повернися, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і врятуй мене! Спаси мене, бо {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} любов до мене вірна.

decisions.choice: turn: come back to me
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) means to turn or return. God seems to have turned away; the psalmist asks him to come back. The same verb returns in verse 11, when the enemies "turn back".

decisions.choice: rescue my soul: pull my life out of danger
decisions.reason: The verb (chalats) means to draw out or set free; the soul (nefesh) here is his life, which is at risk (verse 6).

decisions.choice: loyal love: God's faithful love
decisions.reason: As in 5:8, chesed is love that keeps faith. The psalmist appeals to it, not to any claim of his own.

decisions.choice: loyal love (L); love is loyal (B)
decisions.reason: As in 5:8; Readable says "faithful".

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь (L); любовь неизменна (B, R)
decisions.reason: As at 5:8, God's hesed is "неизменная любовь" at every level; Balanced and Readable make it a statement, as the English does.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For there is not in death remembrance of you; in Sheol who will give thanks to you?

en.L: For in death there is no remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; \q in Sheol who will give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.B: For in death no one calls {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to mind. \q Who gives {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks down in Sheol?
en.R: Dead people cannot remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q No one in the place of the dead can thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Car dans la mort il n’y a pas de souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; \q dans le Shéol, qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendra grâce ?
fr.B: Car dans la mort, personne ne se souvient de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Là-bas, au séjour des morts, qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rend grâce ?
fr.R: Les morts ne peuvent pas se souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Au séjour des morts, personne ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier.

sw.L: Kwa maana katika mauti hakuna kukukumbuka; katika Kuzimu ni nani atakayekushukuru?
sw.B: Kwa maana katika kifo hakuna anayekukumbuka. Ni nani anayekushukuru huko chini Kuzimu?
sw.R: Watu waliokufa hawawezi kukukumbuka. Hakuna mtu aliye Kuzimu anayeweza kukushukuru.

es.L: Porque en la muerte no hay memoria de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q en el Seol, ¿quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará gracias?
es.B: Porque en la muerte nadie se acuerda de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} da gracias allá abajo, en el lugar de los muertos?
es.R: Los muertos no pueden acordarse de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Nadie en el lugar de los muertos puede darte gracias.

vi.L: Vì trong sự chết không có sự nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nơi Âm Phủ ai sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.B: Vì trong cõi chết chẳng ai nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Dưới Âm Phủ, ai cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}?
vi.R: Người chết không thể nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không ai ở nơi của người chết có thể cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 죽음 속에서는 주님을 기억함이 없으니, 스올에서 누가 주님께 감사하겠습니까?
ko.B: 죽으면 아무도 주님을 기억하지 못합니다. 스올에서 누가 주님께 감사를 드리겠습니까?
ko.R: 죽은 사람은 주님을 기억할 수 없습니다. 죽은 사람들이 있는 곳에서는 아무도 주님께 감사할 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Porque na morte não há lembrança de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; \q no Sheol quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dará graças?
pt.B: Pois na morte ninguém se lembra de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dá graças lá no mundo dos mortos?
pt.R: Os mortos não conseguem se lembrar de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Ninguém no mundo dos mortos pode {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer.

am.L: በሞት አንተን ማሰብ የለምና፤ በሲኦል ማን ያመሰግንሃል?
am.B: በሞት ያለ ማንም አያስታውስህምና። በሙታን ዓለም ማን ያመሰግንሃል?
am.R: የሞቱ ሰዎች አንተን ማስታወስ አይችሉም። በሙታን ዓለም ያለ ማንም ሊያመሰግንህ አይችልም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मृत्यु में तेरा स्मरण नहीं [होता]; शिओल में कौन तेरा धन्यवाद करेगा?
hi.B: क्योंकि मृत्यु में कोई तुझे याद नहीं करता। नीचे अधोलोक में कौन तेरा धन्यवाद करता है?
hi.R: मरे हुए लोग तुझे याद नहीं कर सकते। मृत्यु के लोक में कोई तेरा धन्यवाद नहीं कर सकता।

ru.L: Ведь в смерти нет памяти о {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; в шеоле кто будет благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}?
ru.B: Ведь в смерти никто не вспоминает о {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Кто благодарит {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} там, внизу, в мире мёртвых?
ru.R: Мёртвые не могут помнить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Никто в мире мёртвых не может благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}.

ja.L: まことに、死の中にはあなたを覚えることがない。陰府で、だれがあなたに感謝するだろうか？
ja.B: 死んでしまえば、だれもあなたを思い起こさない。陰府の底で、だれがあなたに感謝するだろうか？
ja.R: 死んだ人は、あなたを思い出すことができない。死者の世界では、だれもあなたに感謝することができない。

uk.L: Бо в смерті немає згадки про {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}; у шеолі хто дякуватиме {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}?
uk.B: Бо в смерті ніхто не згадує {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Хто дякує {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} там, у світі мертвих?
uk.R: Мертві не можуть памʼятати {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Ніхто у світі мертвих не може дякувати {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}.

decisions.choice: Sheol: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead, pictured below the earth, where all go down at death (Genesis 37:35). It is not a place of punishment in particular.

decisions.choice: no remembrance, no thanks: a reason for God to save
decisions.reason: To remember God (zeker) here is to call on him and speak of him in praise. If the psalmist dies, God loses a voice that thanks him (Psalm 30:10; Isaiah 38:18). The psalm is not teaching what happens after death; it pleads for life now. Later Scripture speaks more fully of hope beyond death (Isaiah 26:19; Daniel 12:2).

decisions.choice: the place of the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says what Sheol is (m1); Literal and Balanced keep the name.

decisions.choice: Sheol: "le Shéol" (Literal), "le séjour des morts" (Balanced, Readable), for the whole book
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (m1), not hell. Literal keeps the name; the other levels say what it is.

decisions.choice: "Kuzimu" for Sheol at every level, through the Psalms
decisions.reason: "Kuzimu" is the Swahili word for the world of the dead below, so it says what Sheol is (m1) at every level and needs no explanation at Readable, where the English says "the place of the dead". "Kaburi" would name one tomb only.

decisions.choice: el Seol (L); el lugar de los muertos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Sheol is the place of the dead. Literal keeps the name "el Seol"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, "el lugar de los muertos". "El infierno" would bring in the later idea of punishment.

decisions.choice: "Âm Phủ" (L, B); "nơi của người chết" (R), as Psalm 139:8
decisions.reason: The place of the dead is named as in the published Psalm 139:8, through the book: "Âm Phủ" is the word Bible readers know, and Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "스올" (L, B); "죽은 사람들이 있는 곳" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the published Psalm 139:8: the place of the dead (meaning decision m1). "음부" is an older church word few readers know, "무덤" is one grave, and "지옥" says a place of punishment. This holds for Sheol through Psalms 6-25.

decisions.choice: o Sheol (L); o mundo dos mortos (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the Old Testament terms set it: Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable say what Sheol is, the place of the dead (m1), where the English Balanced keeps "Sheol". "Inferno" would suggest a place of punishment, which Sheol is not, and "sepultura" is one grave.

decisions.choice: Sheol as "ሲኦል" (L), "የሙታን ዓለም" (the world of the dead, B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms list and 2 Samuel 22:6: "ሲኦል" now often means hell, so Balanced and Readable name the place of the dead plainly (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "शिओल" (L), "अधोलोक" (B), "मृत्यु का लोक" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheol, the place of the dead (meaning m1), takes the forms of 2 Samuel 22 in this translation, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: шеол (L); мир мёртвых (B, R)
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of the dead (m1). The Psalms terms note keeps the name at Literal and says "мир мёртвых" at Balanced and Readable, as 2 Samuel 22 does; "ад" would bring in a place of punishment.

decisions.choice: Sheol "陰府" (L, B), "死者の世界" (R); for the Psalter, even where the English Readable says grave
decisions.reason: The NT table and Job's forms; qever (the grave itself) stays 墓.

decisions.choice: "шеол" (L), "світ мертвих" (B, R) for Sheol, through the book
decisions.reason: Sheol is the place of all the dead, not of punishment; Literal keeps the Hebrew name, and Balanced and Readable say what it is, as Revelation's Hades is rendered.

source.text: יָגַ֤עְתִּי׀בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכָל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I am weary with my groaning; I make swim every night my bed; with my tears my couch I melt.

en.L: I am weary with my groaning; every night I make my bed swim; \q with my tears I melt my couch.
en.B: I am exhausted from groaning. Night after night my bed swims with my tears, \q and my couch dissolves in them.
en.R: I am tired out from groaning. \q Every night I cry so much that my bed is soaked with my tears.

fr.L: Je suis épuisé par mon gémissement ; chaque nuit je fais nager mon lit ; \q de mes larmes je fais fondre ma couche.
fr.B: Je suis à bout de forces à force de gémir. \q Nuit après nuit mon lit nage dans mes larmes, et ma couche s’y dissout.
fr.R: Je suis fatigué de gémir. \q Chaque nuit, je pleure tellement que mon lit est trempé de larmes.

sw.L: Nimechoka kwa kuugua kwangu; kila usiku ninakiogelesha kitanda changu; kwa machozi yangu ninayayeyusha malazi yangu.
sw.B: Nimechoka kabisa kwa kuugua. Usiku baada ya usiku kitanda changu kinaogelea katika machozi yangu, na malazi yangu yanayeyuka ndani yake.
sw.R: Nimechoka sana kwa kuugua. Kila usiku ninalia sana hata kitanda changu kinaloa kwa machozi yangu.

es.L: Estoy cansado de mi gemir; cada noche hago nadar mi cama; \q con mis lágrimas derrito mi lecho.
es.B: Estoy agotado de tanto gemir. Noche tras noche mi cama nada en mis lágrimas, \q y mi lecho se deshace en ellas.
es.R: Estoy rendido de tanto gemir. \q Cada noche lloro tanto que mi cama queda empapada de lágrimas.

vi.L: Tôi mệt mỏi vì than thở; mỗi đêm tôi làm giường tôi bơi; bằng nước mắt tôi làm tan chảy chỗ nằm của tôi.
vi.B: Tôi kiệt sức vì rên siết. Đêm này qua đêm khác giường tôi ngập trong nước mắt, và chỗ nằm của tôi rã ra vì chúng.
vi.R: Tôi mệt lả vì than khóc. Đêm nào tôi cũng khóc nhiều đến nỗi giường tôi ướt đẫm nước mắt.

ko.L: 제가 탄식으로 지쳤습니다. 밤마다 제 침상을 떠다니게 하고, 제 눈물로 제 잠자리를 녹입니다.
ko.B: 저는 신음하다 지쳤습니다. 밤마다 제 침대는 눈물에 떠다니고, 제 잠자리는 눈물에 녹아내립니다.
ko.R: 저는 신음하다 지쳐 버렸습니다. 밤마다 너무 울어서 제 침대가 눈물에 흠뻑 젖습니다.

pt.L: Estou cansado do meu gemido; toda noite faço nadar a minha cama; \q com as minhas lágrimas derreto o meu leito.
pt.B: Estou esgotado de tanto gemer. Noite após noite a minha cama nada nas minhas lágrimas, \q e o meu leito se desfaz nelas.
pt.R: Estou exausto de tanto gemer. \q Toda noite eu choro tanto que a minha cama fica encharcada de lágrimas.

am.L: በመቃተቴ ደከምኩ፤ በየሌሊቱ አልጋዬን አዋኘዋለሁ፤ በእንባዬም መኝታዬን አቀልጣለሁ።
am.B: ከመቃተት የተነሣ ዝያለሁ። ሌሊት ሌሊት አልጋዬ በእንባዬ ይዋኛል፤ መኝታዬም በእርሱ ይቀልጣል።
am.R: ከማቃሰት የተነሣ ደክሜአለሁ። በየሌሊቱ ብዙ ስለማለቅስ አልጋዬ በእንባዬ ርሷል።

hi.L: मैं अपने कराहने से थक गया हूँ; हर रात मैं अपने बिछौने को तैराता हूँ; अपने आँसुओं से मैं अपनी खाट को गला देता हूँ।
hi.B: मैं कराहते-कराहते थक गया हूँ। रात-रात भर मेरा बिछौना मेरे आँसुओं में तैरता है, और मेरी खाट उनमें गल जाती है।
hi.R: मैं कराहते-कराहते थक चुका हूँ। हर रात मैं इतना रोता हूँ कि मेरा बिस्तर मेरे आँसुओं से भीग जाता है।

ru.L: Я изнемог от стенаний моих; каждую ночь я заставляю плыть мою постель; слезами моими я растапливаю моё ложе.
ru.B: Я измучен стонами. Ночь за ночью моя постель плывёт в моих слезах, и моё ложе растворяется в них.
ru.R: Я устал стонать. Каждую ночь я так плачу, что моя постель мокрая от слёз.

ja.L: わたしは嘆きによって疲れ果てた。夜ごとに、わたしは寝床を泳がせ、涙によって長いすを溶かす。
ja.B: わたしは、うめき疲れた。夜ごとに、寝床は涙で泳ぐほどになり、長いすは涙に溶けてしまう。
ja.R: わたしは、うめいてばかりで、疲れ果てた。毎晩、泣いてばかりいるので、寝床は涙でびっしょりだ。

uk.L: Я змучився від свого стогону; щоночі я змушую плавати моє ложе; своїми сльозами я розмиваю свою постіль.
uk.B: Я виснажився від стогону. Ніч у ніч моє ложе пливе від сліз, і постіль моя розмокає в них.
uk.R: Я втомився стогнати. Щоночі я так плачу, що моя постіль мокра від сліз.

decisions.choice: I make my bed swim, I melt my couch: weeping without end
decisions.reason: The pictures are deliberate overstatement: so many tears that the bed swims and the couch melts. Night, when others sleep (3:6; 4:9), is when his grief is worst.

decisions.choice: groaning: sighing in pain
decisions.reason: The word ('anachah) is a groan or sigh of distress.

decisions.choice: I cry so much that my bed is soaked
alternatives: I make my bed swim; I melt my couch
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the pictures mean (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Wasted from grief is my eye; it has grown old because of all my foes.

en.L: My eye has wasted away from grief; \q it has grown old because of all my foes.
en.B: Grief has dimmed my eyes; \q they have aged because of all who oppose me.
en.R: I have cried so much that I can hardly see. \q My eyes are worn out because of all my enemies.

fr.L: Mon œil est consumé de chagrin ; \q il a vieilli à cause de tous mes adversaires.
fr.B: Le chagrin a obscurci mes yeux ; \q ils ont vieilli à cause de tous ceux qui s’opposent à moi.
fr.R: J’ai tant pleuré que j’y vois à peine. \q Mes yeux sont usés à cause de tous mes ennemis.

sw.L: Jicho langu limedhoofika kwa huzuni; limezeeka kwa sababu ya watesi wangu wote.
sw.B: Huzuni imeyafifiza macho yangu; yamezeeka kwa sababu ya wote wanaonipinga.
sw.R: Nimelia sana hata siwezi kuona vizuri. Macho yangu yamechoka kwa sababu ya adui zangu wote.

es.L: Mi ojo se ha consumido de pesar; \q ha envejecido a causa de todos mis adversarios.
es.B: La tristeza ha nublado mis ojos; \q han envejecido por culpa de todos los que se me oponen.
es.R: He llorado tanto que casi no puedo ver. \q Mis ojos están gastados por culpa de todos mis enemigos.

vi.L: Mắt tôi đã hao mòn vì sầu khổ; nó đã già đi vì mọi kẻ thù của tôi.
vi.B: Nỗi sầu khổ làm mắt tôi mờ đi; mắt tôi đã già đi vì mọi kẻ chống đối tôi.
vi.R: Tôi khóc nhiều đến nỗi gần như không còn thấy rõ. Mắt tôi mỏi mòn vì mọi kẻ thù của tôi.

ko.L: 제 눈이 슬픔으로 쇠하였고, 제 모든 대적 때문에 늙었습니다.
ko.B: 슬픔으로 제 눈이 흐려졌고, 저를 대적하는 모든 자 때문에 눈이 늙어 버렸습니다.
ko.R: 너무 울어서 앞이 잘 보이지 않습니다. 제 원수들 때문에 제 눈이 지쳐 버렸습니다.

pt.L: O meu olho se gastou de desgosto; \q tornou-se velho por causa de todos os meus inimigos.
pt.B: O desgosto escureceu os meus olhos; \q eles envelheceram por causa de todos os que se opõem a mim.
pt.R: Eu chorei tanto que mal consigo enxergar. \q Os meus olhos estão cansados por causa de todos os meus inimigos.

am.L: ዓይኔ ከኀዘን የተነሣ ደከመች፤ ከባላጋራዎቼ ሁሉ የተነሣ አረጀች።
am.B: ኀዘን ዓይኖቼን አፈዘዘ፤ ከሚቃወሙኝ ሁሉ የተነሣ አረጁ።
am.R: ብዙ ከማልቀሴ የተነሣ ማየት እንኳ ያቅተኛል። ከጠላቶቼ ሁሉ የተነሣ ዓይኖቼ ደክመዋል።

hi.L: मेरी आँख शोक से धुँधला गई है; मेरे सब बैरियों के कारण वह बूढ़ी हो गई है।
hi.B: शोक ने मेरी आँखें धुँधली कर दी हैं; मेरे सब विरोधियों के कारण वे बूढ़ी हो गई हैं।
hi.R: मैं इतना रोया हूँ कि मुझे ठीक से दिखाई भी नहीं देता। मेरे सब दुश्मनों के कारण मेरी आँखें थक गई हैं।

ru.L: Угасло от горя моё око; оно состарилось из-за всех моих противников.
ru.B: Горе затуманило мои глаза; они постарели из-за всех, кто против меня.
ru.R: Я так много плакал, что почти ничего не вижу. Мои глаза измучены из-за всех моих врагов.

ja.L: わたしの目は悲しみによって衰え、わたしのすべての仇のゆえに老いてしまった。
ja.B: 悲しみのために、わたしの目はかすみ、わたしに逆らう者たちのゆえに、衰えてしまった。
ja.R: 泣きすぎて、もうよく見えない。敵たちのせいで、わたしの目は疲れ切ってしまった。

uk.L: Моє око змарніло від горя; воно постаріло через усіх моїх супротивників.
uk.B: Горе затьмарило мої очі; вони постаріли через усіх, хто проти мене.
uk.R: Я так багато плакав, що ледве бачу. Мої очі змучені через усіх моїх ворогів.

decisions.choice: my eye has wasted away: my strength is failing
decisions.reason: Bright eyes are a sign of strength and life (1 Samuel 14:27); dim eyes, of grief and weakness. Psalm 31:10 uses the same words: "my eye wastes away from grief" (also Job 17:7).

decisions.choice: grief: sorrow mixed with vexation
decisions.reason: The word (ka'as) is grief that has anger or provocation in it, here caused by his enemies.

decisions.choice: I have cried so much that I can hardly see
alternatives: my eye has wasted away from grief
decisions.reason: Readable says how grief has worn out his eyes, linking this verse to the tears of verse 7.

source.text: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Turn away from me, all doers of iniquity, for YHWH has heard the sound of my weeping.

en.L: Depart from me, all workers of iniquity, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has heard the sound of my weeping.
en.B: Get away from me, all who practice evil, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me weeping.
en.R: Go away, all you who do evil! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me crying.

fr.L: Éloignez-vous de moi, vous tous qui pratiquez l’iniquité, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a entendu le son de mes pleurs.
fr.B: Allez-vous-en loin de moi, vous tous qui faites le mal, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu pleurer.
fr.R: Partez, vous tous qui faites le mal ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu pleurer.

sw.L: Tokeni mbele yangu, enyi nyote mfanyao uovu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesikia sauti ya kulia kwangu.
sw.B: Nendeni mbali nami, ninyi nyote mnaotenda maovu, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikilia.
sw.R: Ondokeni, ninyi nyote mnaotenda maovu! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikilia.

es.L: {{plural_you:Apártense|Apartaos}} de mí, todos los que hacen iniquidad, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha oído la voz de mi llanto.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de mí, todos los que practican el mal, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído llorar!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Váyanse|Marchaos}}, todos los que hacen el mal! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído llorar.

vi.L: Hãy lìa xa tôi, hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều gian ác, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tiếng khóc của tôi.
vi.B: Hãy tránh xa tôi, hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi khóc.
vi.R: Hỡi tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác, hãy đi đi! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi khóc.

ko.L: 악을 행하는 모든 자들아, 내게서 떠나가라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 울음소리를 들으셨다.
ko.B: 악을 일삼는 자들아, 모두 내게서 물러가라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내가 우는 소리를 들으셨다.
ko.R: 악한 일을 하는 자들아, 모두 물러가라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내가 우는 소리를 들으셨다.

pt.L: Afastem-se de mim, todos os que praticam a iniquidade, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu a voz do meu choro.
pt.B: Afastem-se de mim, todos os que praticam o mal, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu chorar.
pt.R: Saiam de perto de mim, todos vocês que fazem o mal! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu chorando.

am.L: እናንተ የዓመፅ ሠራተኞች ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ራቁ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የልቅሶዬን ድምፅ ሰምቷልና።
am.B: እናንተ በደል የምትሠሩ ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ሂዱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ልቅሶዬን ሰምቷልና።
am.R: እናንተ ክፉ ነገር የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ራቁ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ልቅሶዬን ሰምቷል።

hi.L: हे अधर्म के सब काम करनेवालो, मुझसे दूर हो जाओ, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मेरे रोने का शब्द सुन लिया है।
hi.B: हे बुरे काम करनेवालो, तुम सब मुझसे दूर हो जाओ, क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे रोते हुए सुन लिया है।
hi.R: मुझसे दूर हो जाओ, तुम सब जो बुरे काम करते हो! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे रोते हुए सुन लिया है।

ru.L: Отойдите от меня, все, кто творит неправду, ведь {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал голос моего плача.
ru.B: Уйдите от меня, все, кто делает зло, потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал, как я плачу.
ru.R: Уходите, все, кто делает зло! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал, как я плачу.

ja.L: わたしから離れ去れ、悪を行う者たちよ、みな。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、わたしの泣く声を聞かれたからだ。
ja.B: 悪を行う者たちよ、みな、わたしから去れ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、わたしの泣く声を聞いてくださったのだ。
ja.R: 悪いことをする者たちよ、みな、わたしから離れて行け！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしが泣いているのを聞いてくださった。

uk.L: Відійдіть від мене, усі, хто чинить беззаконня, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув голос мого плачу.
uk.B: Геть від мене, усі, хто чинить зло, бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув, як я плачу.
uk.R: Ідіть геть, усі ви, хто чинить зло! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув, як я плачу.

decisions.choice: Depart from me ... for the LORD has heard: a sudden turn
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from weeping to confidence. Many prayers for help turn in this way, once the one praying is sure God has heard (Psalm 22:22; 28:6).

decisions.choice: Depart from me, workers of iniquity: Jesus' words
decisions.reason: Jesus uses these words for those he will send away at the judgment (Matthew 7:23; Luke 13:27).

decisions.choice: workers of iniquity: those who practice evil
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used in 5:6.

decisions.choice: Verses 9-11 speak to the evildoers and about the LORD in 해라체, and the psalmist is "나"
alternatives: 저 and 합쇼체 as in verses 2-8
decisions.reason: The psalm turns suddenly from praying to God to sending away the enemies (meaning decision m1); Korean speaks to them as one sends people away, as in the published Psalm 139:19, and speaks of the LORD in the plain written style with the honorific.

decisions.choice: Afastem-se de mim (L, B); Saiam de perto de mim (R)
decisions.reason: Jesus uses these words at the judgment (m2), and Matthew 7:23 says them in Portuguese as "afastem-se de mim" (L, B) and "Saiam de perto de mim" (R); the psalm uses the same words.

decisions.choice: The words Jesus takes up in Luke 13:27, in the Amharic New Testament's wording: "እናንተ የዓመፅ ሠራተኞች ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ራቁ" (L), "እናንተ በደል የምትሠሩ ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ሂዱ" (B), "እናንተ ክፉ ነገር የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፣ ከእኔ ራቁ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek in Luke 13:27 (and Matthew 7:23) agrees with the Hebrew here (meaning decision m2), so each level keeps the Luke wording.

decisions.choice: "हे अधर्म के सब काम करनेवालो, मुझसे दूर हो जाओ" (L) and the Balanced and Readable wording of Luke 13:27
decisions.reason: Jesus takes up these words in Matthew 7:23 and Luke 13:27 (meaning m2); the Hindi keeps the wording of Luke 13:27, which like the psalm says "all", at each level, in this translation. The psalmist speaks to his enemies with "तुम".

decisions.choice: Отойдите от меня, все, кто творит неправду (L); Уйдите (B), Уходите (R) ... кто делает зло
decisions.reason: Jesus uses these words in Luke 13:27 and Matthew 7:23 (m2); Russian takes the wording of Luke 13:27, whose Greek is closest to the Hebrew "workers of iniquity", and keeps the phrase of 5:6 (творит неправду at Literal, делает зло at Balanced and Readable).

decisions.choice: "わたしから離れ去れ" (L), "わたしから去れ" (B), "わたしから離れて行け！" (R), as Jesus' words in Matthew 7:23 and Luke 13:27, with po'alei 'awen kept as "悪を行う者たち"
decisions.reason: The command matches the Gospels' Japanese (m2), but the Hebrew names doers of 'awen, not of lawlessness, so the Psalter's own phrase (5:6) is kept instead of Matthew's 不法 or Luke's 不義.

source.text: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has heard my plea for grace; YHWH will accept my prayer.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard my plea for grace; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take my prayer.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me beg for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} welcomes my prayer.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has heard me ask for mercy. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} takes my prayer to heart.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a entendu ma supplication ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra ma prière.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu implorer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} accueille ma prière.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a entendu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demander pitié. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend ma prière à cœur.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesikia ombi langu la neema; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atayapokea maombi yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikiomba neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayakaribisha maombi yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenisikia nikiomba rehema. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayajali sana maombi yangu.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha oído mi súplica; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} recibirá mi oración.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído rogar por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acoge mi oración.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha oído pedir misericordia. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} recibe mi oración con cariño.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe lời tôi nài xin ân huệ; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi nài xin ân huệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đón nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nghe tôi xin thương xót. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghi nhận lời cầu nguyện của tôi.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 간구를 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 받으실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 은혜를 구하는 내 간청을 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 받아 주신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 불쌍히 여겨 달라는 내 부르짖음을 들으셨다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 기도를 마음에 두신다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu o meu pedido de graça; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tomará a minha oração.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu implorar pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça; \q {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} recebe bem a minha oração.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me ouviu pedir misericórdia. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} leva a sério a minha oração.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምሕረትን ለማግኘት ያቀረብኩትን ልመና ሰምቷል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸሎቴን ይቀበላል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሞገሱን እንዲያሳየኝ ስለምን ሰምቶኛል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸሎቴን በደስታ ይቀበላል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ምሕረት ስለምን ሰምቶኛል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸሎቴን በልቡ ይይዛል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मेरा गिड़गिड़ाना सुन लिया है; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी प्रार्थना ग्रहण करेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अनुग्रह के लिए मेरी विनती सुन ली है; {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी प्रार्थना स्वीकार करते हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दया के लिए मेरी पुकार सुन ली है। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरी प्रार्थना पर ध्यान देते हैं।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал моё прошение о милости; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} возьмёт мою молитву.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал, как я умоляю {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} о милости; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} принимает мою молитву.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} услышал, как я прошу о милости. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} принимает мою молитву близко к сердцу.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしの嘆願を聞かれた。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はわたしの祈りを受け入れられる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、恵みを求めるわたしの願いを聞いてくださった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの祈りを受け入れてくださる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、あわれみを願うわたしの声を聞いてくださった。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしの祈りを心に留めてくださる。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув моє благання про милість; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} прийме мою молитву.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув, як я благаю {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} про милість; {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} приймає мою молитву.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} почув, як я прошу милосердя. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} бере мою молитву до серця.

decisions.choice: plea for grace: a request for favor
decisions.reason: The word (techinnah) comes from the verb of verse 3, "be gracious": a plea for grace.

decisions.choice: will take: accept, receive with favor
decisions.reason: To take (laqach) a prayer is to receive it. The past "has heard" and the future "will take" both express certainty.

decisions.choice: beg for his grace
decisions.reason: Balanced says whose grace is asked for, as verse 3 does.

source.text: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃

records.literal_gloss: They will be ashamed and terrified exceedingly, all my enemies; they will turn back, they will be ashamed in a moment.

en.L: All my enemies will be ashamed and greatly terrified; \q they will turn back [and] be ashamed in a moment.
en.B: All my enemies will be put to shame and filled with terror; \q they will turn back, suddenly disgraced.
en.R: All my enemies will be ashamed and very afraid. \q They will suddenly turn and run away in shame.

fr.L: Tous mes ennemis seront couverts de honte et grandement épouvantés ; \q ils reculeront, [ils seront] honteux en un instant.
fr.B: Tous mes ennemis seront couverts de honte et remplis de terreur ; \q ils reculeront, déshonorés tout à coup.
fr.R: Tous mes ennemis auront honte et très peur. \q Tout à coup, ils feront demi-tour et s’enfuiront, couverts de honte.

sw.L: Adui zangu wote wataaibika na kutetemeka kwa hofu mno; watarudi nyuma [na] kuaibika mara moja.
sw.B: Adui zangu wote wataaibishwa na kujawa na hofu; watarudi nyuma, wakiaibishwa ghafla.
sw.R: Adui zangu wote wataona aibu na kuogopa sana. Watageuka ghafla na kukimbia kwa aibu.

es.L: Todos mis enemigos serán avergonzados y muy aterrados; \q se volverán atrás [y] serán avergonzados en un momento.
es.B: Todos mis enemigos quedarán en vergüenza y llenos de terror; \q se volverán atrás, deshonrados de repente.
es.R: Todos mis enemigos quedarán avergonzados y con mucho miedo. \q De pronto se darán la vuelta y huirán llenos de vergüenza.

vi.L: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị hổ thẹn và kinh hãi vô cùng; chúng sẽ quay lui [và] bị hổ thẹn trong chốc lát.
vi.B: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị sỉ nhục và đầy kinh hoàng; chúng sẽ quay lui, bỗng chốc bị hổ thẹn.
vi.R: Mọi kẻ thù của tôi sẽ bị xấu hổ và rất sợ hãi. Chúng sẽ bất ngờ quay lưng bỏ chạy trong nhục nhã.

ko.L: 내 모든 원수가 부끄러워하며 몹시 떨 것이다. 그들이 물러가 순식간에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.
ko.B: 내 모든 원수가 수치를 당하고 공포에 질릴 것이다. 그들은 갑자기 망신을 당하고 물러갈 것이다.
ko.R: 내 원수들은 모두 부끄러워하고 몹시 두려워할 것이다. 그들은 갑자기 부끄러워하며 달아날 것이다.

pt.L: Todos os meus inimigos serão envergonhados e ficarão muito apavorados; \q voltarão atrás [e] serão envergonhados num instante.
pt.B: Todos os meus inimigos serão humilhados e ficarão cheios de terror; \q voltarão atrás, cobertos de vergonha de repente.
pt.R: Todos os meus inimigos vão ficar envergonhados e com muito medo. \q De repente, eles vão dar meia-volta e fugir envergonhados.

am.L: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ እጅግም ይሸበራሉ፤ ወደ ኋላ ይመለሳሉ፤ በድንገትም ያፍራሉ።
am.B: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይዋረዳሉ፤ በፍርሃትም ይሞላሉ፤ በድንገት ተዋርደው ወደ ኋላ ይመለሳሉ።
am.R: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ያፍራሉ፤ እጅግም ይፈራሉ። በድንገት ዞረው በኀፍረት ይሸሻሉ።

hi.L: मेरे सब शत्रु लज्जित होंगे और बहुत घबरा जाएँगे; वे पीछे हटेंगे, [और] पल भर में लज्जित होंगे।
hi.B: मेरे सब शत्रु लज्जित होंगे और भय से भर जाएँगे; वे पीछे हटेंगे, अचानक अपमानित होकर।
hi.R: मेरे सब दुश्मन लज्जित होंगे और बहुत डर जाएँगे। वे अचानक मुड़कर शर्म के मारे भाग जाएँगे।

ru.L: Будут пристыжены и сильно напуганы все мои враги; они повернут назад [и] будут пристыжены в одно мгновение.
ru.B: Все мои враги будут посрамлены и охвачены ужасом; они повернут назад, внезапно опозоренные.
ru.R: Все мои враги будут опозорены и очень напуганы. Они вдруг повернутся и убегут со стыдом.

ja.L: わたしの敵はみな恥を受け、ひどくおののく。彼らは退き、たちまち恥を受ける。
ja.B: わたしの敵はみな恥を受け、恐れに満たされる。彼らは退き、たちまち恥を見る。
ja.R: わたしの敵はみな恥をかき、とてもこわがる。そして急に向きを変え、恥ずかしい思いをして逃げて行く。

uk.L: Усі мої вороги будуть осоромлені й дуже нажахані; вони повернуть назад [і] будуть осоромлені вмить.
uk.B: Усі мої вороги зазнають сорому й сповняться жаху; вони повернуть назад, раптом зганьблені.
uk.R: Усі мої вороги будуть присоромлені й дуже налякані. Вони раптом обернуться й утечуть із ганьбою.

decisions.choice: will be ashamed: a statement of confidence
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as what will happen or as a wish. Following verses 9-10, they are read as confidence.

decisions.choice: terrified, turn back: the tables turned
decisions.reason: The enemies are "terrified" with the verb used of the psalmist's bones and soul (verses 3-4), and they "turn back" with the verb he used when he asked the LORD to turn (verse 5).

decisions.choice: in a moment: suddenly
decisions.reason: The word (rega') is an instant. The long nights of weeping end with a sudden reversal.
